method.bodySplit: exact blank-line delimiter (two consecutive LF characters)
method.exactEnglishParagraph: learner paragraph exactly matches a canonical source paragraph; match may occur at any position to avoid shifts from paragraph-boundary changes
method.draftParagraph: learner paragraph that is not an exact canonical paragraph; may still retain English technical phrases
method.assessment: compare every learner key point, quiz question, quiz option and rationale string to its canonical English field; count exact matches and non-exact drafts
method.sourceBinding: production resolver uses the registered translation source-pairs and fails closed on source mismatch or answer-index/order mismatch

limitations: Non-exact means changed from the English source, not fluent, fully localized or approved.
Mixed-language paragraphs are counted as non-exact drafts even when English technical terms remain.
Canonical paragraphs not seen verbatim can be translated, combined, split or absent; this count does not distinguish those causes.
Exact-English counts include exact held/source fallback paragraphs; the audit does not label why a field remains English.
Content only: slide text, narration, audio, infographic text and human review approval are not counted.
